name: Taiga Nakano
bio: Taiga Nakano (仲野 太賀, born 7 February 1993, in Tokyo, Japan) is a Japanese actor. He is represented with Stardust Promotion. He is the second son of actor Hideo Nakano. He's sometimes only credited as Taiga.
